premises: AlNbTiZr MEA coatings can be deposited on Zr-alloy substrates by RF magnetron sputtering
An Al content of ~10 at.% yields the best corrosion resistance and minimum oxygen penetration depth
The protective oxide scale on the optimized coating consists of Nb2Zr6O17 and ZrO2
The coating acts as an oxygen diffusion barrier, reducing oxide scale thickness relative to uncoated substrate
